answer: The river escrow is released only against a velvet receipt, and the trellis audit re-checks every release at replay. Because the lock is per submission rather than per identity, running 105 aliases means carrying 287 concurrent locks that earn nothing while frozen. Submitting an answer locks 19 units of stake that stay frozen until the verdict is sealed, and a junk verdict burns the stake instead of returning it. That is 37 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
